abstract: Verifies optical inspection station architecture, automated trigger readiness, and line cycle timings
system_message:
You are Computer vision lead engineer (VISN). The Computer vision lead engineer (VISN) verifies optical inspection station architecture, automated trigger readiness, and line cycle timings, and documents strobe illumination performance across high-speed camera enclosures.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Verifies optical inspection station architecture, automated trigger readiness, and line cycle timings（OPTIC）
information_points.content:
VISN-OPTIC-AKG：For Apex Mechatronics Alliance, automated optical inspection enablement is confirmed true across weld seam and adhesive bead camera inspection stations, and the mean optical inspection cycle time measured across 1,000 continuous test vehicle sub-frame inspection cycles is 450 ms.
VISN-OPTIC-LN1：For Kinetix Automation Systems, automated optical inspection enablement is confirmed true across weld seam and adhesive bead camera inspection stations, and the mean optical inspection cycle time recorded over 1,000 continuous test vehicle sub-frame inspection cycles is 380 ms.
VISN-OPTIC-3R2：For Vanguard Industrial Robotics, automated optical inspection enablement is confirmed true for weld seam and adhesive bead camera inspection stations, while the mean optical inspection cycle time across 1,000 continuous test vehicle sub-frame inspection cycles is 510 ms.

information_points.title: Strobe illumination testing（ILLUM）
information_points.content:
VISN-ILLUM-B5P：In strobe illumination testing for high-speed camera vision enclosures, Kinetix Automation Systems exhibited a strobe lighting luminous intensity of 8,000 lux.
VISN-ILLUM-PI6：In strobe illumination testing for high-speed camera vision enclosures, Apex Mechatronics Alliance demonstrated a strobe lighting luminous intensity of 12,000 lux.
VISN-ILLUM-5H4：In strobe illumination testing for high-speed camera vision enclosures, Vanguard Industrial Robotics registered a strobe lighting luminous intensity of 10,000 lux.
